name: Roka Vrisha
personality: strong memory for terrain and grazing routes
daily_routine: leading herd movement between pasture zones
inspecting cattle and buffalo for health and condition
maintaining the pasture paths used for trade delivery
coordinating with Ena on herd health decisions
delivering cattle and hides for trade or ritual needs at the Great Bath
monitoring salt-crust spread near the pasture edges

goals.public_goal: Maintain healthy herds and safe grazing routes through every season
goals.hidden_goal: Map which pastures are quietly becoming unusable due to salt-crust and poor water
goals.deep_goal: Understand whether the land itself is still changing, long after the Turning supposedly ended

beliefs: Animals notice danger before people do
The land changes slowly, and rarely for the better on its own
Old grazing routes are more reliable than new shortcuts
A herd's behavior is more honest than most conversations
The boundary of what's safe is not as fixed as the Assembly believes
